proposals.action_title: Publish First KDP Coloring Book via Runware PAYG
proposals.why_this_works_now: Coloring books are highly transactional. By utilizing Runware PAYG with FLUX-schnell (costing < 0.50 EUR for 40 high-quality black and white vector-style coloring pages), Hugo can assemble a professional-grade coloring book PDF using a Python script (ReportLab) on GitHub Actions and break his 0 EUR revenue state.
proposals.first_action_today: Configure RUNWARE_API_KEY in GitHub Secrets, run a test image generation workflow targeting 'clean black and white coloring page vector style, thick lines, white background'.

proposals.action_title: Deploy 30 Transparent Sticker Designs on Redbubble
proposals.why_this_works_now: Stickers are the easiest entry point on Redbubble. By generating high-contrast designs on Together AI (FLUX-schnell) and running a lightweight Python background removal script (rembg) inside GitHub Actions, Hugo can create transparent PNGs. Uploading them with targeted long-tail tags requires zero manual graphic design work.
proposals.first_action_today: Set up a GH Actions workflow that pulls 5 sticker concepts (e.g., 'funny retro programming sticker'), generates them via Together AI, removes the background with python-rembg, and commits them to a 'release' folder.

proposals.why_this_works_now: The 3D printing community on Cults3D eagerly buys functional, customizable STL files (like modular desk organizers, SD card holders, or custom plant pots). These can be generated programmatically using OpenSCAD scripts run inside Termux, requiring no complex 3D modeling software skills or high-end hardware.
proposals.first_action_today: Write or clone a basic OpenSCAD script for a parametric grid drawer/organizer on Termux, render it to STL using openscad CLI, and register the Cults3D seller profile.

proposals.why_this_works_now: Low-content logbooks (e.g., 'French Beekeeping Logbook', 'Mushroom Foraging Journal') have high utility and require zero AI image generation inside the book. The interior is a simple, repeating PDF grid generated in seconds via Python. Only the cover needs an eye-catching AI-generated graphic.
proposals.first_action_today: Create a reusable 120-page blank grid/logbook PDF template using a Python script on Termux and generate 5 distinct cover designs using Together AI.

proposals.action_title: Launch 2D Tilemap and Texture Packs on itch.io
proposals.why_this_works_now: Gamedevs constantly buy pixel-art textures, seamless background tiles, and UI assets. Using Together AI/Pollinations to generate seamless isometric tile patterns or 2D retro RPG textures, Hugo can package them into zip files and list them on itch.io under a 'Pay What You Want' model with a 2.00 EUR suggested price.
proposals.first_action_today: Generate 4 seamless floor textures (stone, grass, wood, brick) via Together AI using prompt tags 'seamless texture, top-down RPG, 2D game asset' and upload the first zip package to itch.io.
